rationale: The bounded user-visible product-semantics change warrants a structured slice. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied. Verified Change is also ineligible because the fixture shows three canonical owners and non-deterministic propagation. This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate, not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
The change affects product semantics and is user-visible.
Three canonical owners and three source paths indicate cross-owner coordination beyond a narrow local quick task.
Derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
No runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact is in
